purpose: Single source of truth for PKM reload tail repairs. import_audio.py reads this and imports the repaired WAV for any asset listed here, so re-running the committed restore entry can no longer silently revert a repaired SoundWave to the raw video cut.
warning: The base cuts in audio_manifest.json still contain the reference video's background music bed. They are inputs to the repair recipes, not deliverables. Do not import them over the assets listed below.

regenerate: BeltAudio22/apply_tail_repair.py -- then import_audio.py (or the per-round _import_*_ue.py inside the running editor).

repairs.note: BGM_FINDINGS.md quoted 314.9 ms for this handover; that figure multiplied by the atempo factor instead of dividing, and the delivered chain lengthens 0.515 s of source to 0.692 s. The source-side handover (437.3 ms) and the shipped audio are correct; only the document was wrong. Confirmed by sample-exact diff: the delivered WAV first differs at 569.3 ms.
Also covers the mid-clip music hole at 267-341 ms that the old last-keepable-frame rule kept.
Same asset also plays as the PKM equip sound (EquipAudio37).

measured_and_left_alone.reason: Tail sits at -54 dBFS; far too short and quiet to read as music.
Below 20 ms the 25 ms envelope smoother is longer than the tail and the level ratio degenerates (first attempt came out 6.5 dB louder). Also -47 dBFS.
The delivered asset is padded with digital silence after 230 ms (apad/atrim), so the trailing region carries no music.

donor.measured_with: 80 Hz highpass applied, matching the authoring chain
donor.why_not_the_20260925_donor: 25.010-25.215 s was chosen from a margin measured WITHOUT the authoring highpass. With the highpass its minimum falls to -2.3 dB and 96-139 ms sits at 2.5-5.1 dB, so a 130-224 ms tail rebuilt from it copies the music back in. A donor's margin is the rebuild's music suppression.
